repo_notes.author: Mario Urquia
repo_notes.content: This repository is the public open-core CRE Skills knowledge and execution layer. Treat source code, tests, generated catalogs/manifests, and explicit status declarations as canonical. The wiki must clearly distinguish: skill instructions from executable runtime; static governance declarations from runtime emitted-output enforcement; live connectors from stub, blocked-by-vendor, experimental, or unsupported connectors; prose/template orchestration from autonomous execution; generated AMOS manifests from live AMOS integration; and fresh-install validation from upgrade, uninstall, and recovery validation. Prioritize src/skills/, src/commands/, routing, calculators, plugin and MCP packaging, catalog/manifest generation, governance scanners and runtime guards, installer/export surfaces, tests, release maturity, and known limitations. Never describe a capability as production-live unless implementation and tests support that status.
